test_GaussianTimeOutSimulator_online_sta: test that GaussianTimeOutSimulator correctly computes online sample mean and variance for training time distribution
test_GaussianTimeOutSimulator_stop_fl: test that GaussianTimeOutSimulator stops federated learning when the total elapsed time exceeds the configured stopping time
test_GaussianTimeOutSimulator_positive_t: test that simulated per-example training time is always positive when a minimum duration is configured
create_GaussianTimeOutSimulator_config: create a GaussianTimeOutSimulator with a configured timeout wall per round, FL stopping time, and Gaussian duration distribution
simulate_training_time_with_GaussianTime: simulate per-example training time and total training time using GaussianTimeOutSimulator for a given number of samples
